views.name: MORTH_Recipie_Variant_View
views.definition:
SELECT part,
    heading,
    description,
    materials,
    machinery,
    labour,
    others,
    unit,
    quantity,
    rate_structure,
    code,
    part AS subject,
    chapter,
    section_heading,
    printed_item,
    description_detail,
    project_category,
    recipe ->> 'analysis_variant'::text AS analysis_variant,
    rate_divisor,
    COALESCE(recipe -> 'addon_table'::text, '[]'::jsonb) AS addon_table,
    source_pages,
    source_edition,
    review_flags,
    sor_mapping_status,
    cost_ready,
    COALESCE(recipe -> 'required_project_parameters'::text, '[]'::jsonb) AS required_project_parameters,
    COALESCE(recipe -> 'notes'::text, '[]'::jsonb) AS notes,
    COALESCE(recipe -> 'source_issues'::text, '[]'::jsonb) AS source_issues,
    recipe -> 'ref_to_m'::text AS specification_reference,
    component_links,
    source_context,
    content_hash,
    created_at,
    updated_at
   FROM morth;

views.name: MORTH_Recipie_View
views.definition:
WITH RECURSIVE states AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT g.code,
            g.source_codes,
            g.project_categories,
            g.representative_code,
            g.dependency_groups,
            g.source_fingerprints,
            g.merge_hash,
            ( SELECT count(*) = 3 AND count(DISTINCT m.project_category) = 3 AND bool_and((g.source_fingerprints ->> m.code) = md5(jsonb_build_array(m.recipe, m.source_context, m.component_links)::text))
                   FROM morth m
                  WHERE m.code = ANY (g.source_codes)) AS valid
           FROM morth_variant_merge g
        ), invalid(code) AS (
         SELECT states.code
           FROM states
          WHERE NOT COALESCE(states.valid, false)
        UNION
         SELECT s.code
           FROM states s
             JOIN invalid i ON i.code = ANY (s.dependency_groups)
        ), active AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT s.code,
            s.source_codes,
            s.project_categories,
            s.representative_code,
            s.dependency_groups,
            s.source_fingerprints,
            s.merge_hash,
            s.valid
           FROM states s
          WHERE s.valid AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM invalid i
                  WHERE i.code = s.code))
        )
 SELECT v.part,
    v.heading,
    v.description,
        CASE
            WHEN a.code IS NULL THEN v.materials
            ELSE COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg((x.c - 'source_quantity_column'::text) || jsonb_build_object('source_quantity_columns', a.project_categories) ORDER BY x.n) AS jsonb_agg
               FROM jsonb_array_elements(v.materials) WITH ORDINALITY x(c, n)), '[]'::jsonb)
        END AS materials,
        CASE
            WHEN a.code IS NULL THEN v.machinery
            ELSE COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg((x.c - 'source_quantity_column'::text) || jsonb_build_object('source_quantity_columns', a.project_categories) ORDER BY x.n) AS jsonb_agg
               FROM jsonb_array_elements(v.machinery) WITH ORDINALITY x(c, n)), '[]'::jsonb)
        END AS machinery,
        CASE
            WHEN a.code IS NULL THEN v.labour
            ELSE COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg((x.c - 'source_quantity_column'::text) || jsonb_build_object('source_quantity_columns', a.project_categories) ORDER BY x.n) AS jsonb_agg
               FROM jsonb_array_elements(v.labour) WITH ORDINALITY x(c, n)), '[]'::jsonb)
        END AS labour,
    v.others,
    v.unit,
    v.quantity,
    v.rate_structure,
    COALESCE(a.code, v.code) AS code,
    v.subject,
    v.chapter,
    v.section_heading,
    v.printed_item,
    v.description_detail,
        CASE
            WHEN a.code IS NULL THEN v.project_category
            ELSE 'all'::text
        END AS project_category,
    v.analysis_variant,
    v.rate_divisor,
    v.addon_table,
    v.source_pages,
    v.source_edition,
    v.review_flags,
    v.sor_mapping_status,
    v.cost_ready,
    v.required_project_parameters,
    v.notes,
    v.source_issues,
    v.specification_reference,
    v.component_links,
    v.source_context,
    v.content_hash,
    v.created_at,
    v.updated_at,
    a.code IS NOT NULL AS is_shared,
        CASE
            WHEN a.code IS NULL THEN ARRAY[v.project_category]
            ELSE a.project_categories
        END AS project_categories,
    COALESCE(a.source_codes, ARRAY[v.code]) AS source_codes,
        CASE
            WHEN a.code IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(COALESCE(v.project_category, 'shared'::text), v.code)
            ELSE ( SELECT jsonb_object_agg(m.project_category, m.code) AS jsonb_object_agg
               FROM morth m
              WHERE m.code = ANY (a.source_codes))
        END AS source_codes_by_category,
    v.code AS representative_code,
    a.merge_hash
   FROM "MORTH_Recipie_Variant_View" v
     LEFT JOIN active a ON v.code = ANY (a.source_codes)
  WHERE a.code IS NULL OR v.code = a.representative_code;

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sor_morth_analysis_rate_valid(v jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare o jsonb; codes text[]:=array[]::text[]; s jsonb;
begin
 if jsonb_typeof(v) is distinct from 'object' or not(v ?& array['schema_version','type','status','options','requirements','reason'])
  or (v-array['schema_version','type','status','options','requirements','reason'])<>'{}'::jsonb
  or v->'schema_version' is distinct from '1'::jsonb or v->>'type' is distinct from 'morth_analysis'
  or coalesce(v->>'status','') not in ('scope_review_required','no_matching_analysis')
  or jsonb_typeof(v->'options') is distinct from 'array'
  or jsonb_typeof(v->'requirements') is distinct from 'array'
  or jsonb_typeof(v->'reason') is distinct from 'string' or length(btrim(v->>'reason'))=0 then return false; end if;
 if jsonb_array_length(v->'options')>512 or jsonb_array_length(v->'requirements')=0
  or ((jsonb_array_length(v->'options')>0)<>(v->>'status'='scope_review_required')) then return false; end if;
 for s in select value from jsonb_array_elements(v->'requirements') loop
  if jsonb_typeof(s)<>'string' or length(btrim(s#>>'{}'))=0 then return false; end if;
 end loop;
 for o in select value from jsonb_array_elements(v->'options') loop
  if jsonb_typeof(o) is distinct from 'object'
   or not(o ?& array['morth_code','relationship','review_status','source_pages','source_edition'])
   or (o-array['morth_code','relationship','review_status','source_pages','source_edition'])<>'{}'::jsonb
   or jsonb_typeof(o->'morth_code') is distinct from 'string' or (o->>'morth_code')!~'^MORTH-.+'
   or coalesce(o->>'relationship','') not in ('whole_work_candidate','component_candidate')
   or o->>'review_status' is distinct from 'scope_review_required'
   or jsonb_typeof(o->'source_edition') is distinct from 'string' or length(btrim(o->>'source_edition'))=0
   or jsonb_typeof(o->'source_pages') not in ('array','object')
   or o->'source_pages' in ('[]'::jsonb,'{}'::jsonb,'null'::jsonb)
   or (o->>'morth_code')=any(codes) then return false; end if;
  codes:=array_append(codes,o->>'morth_code');
 end loop;
 return true;
end $function$

functions.name: sor_morth_referenced_key_guard
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sor_morth_referenced_key_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
begin
 if tg_op='UPDATE' and new.code=old.code and new.recipe->>'source_edition' is not distinct from old.source_edition
  and new.recipe->'source_pages' is not distinct from old.source_pages then return new; end if;
 if exists(select 1 from public."SOR_Year" y cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(y.rate->'options','[]'::jsonb)) o
  where y.rate->>'type'='morth_analysis' and o->>'morth_code'=old.code) then
  raise exception 'MoRTH key/source is referenced by reviewed SOR annual analysis links; reconcile before changing it';
 end if;
 if tg_op='DELETE' then return old; end if; return new;
end $function$

preamble: Bridge general conditions pp403–405: overhead 20% for new/widening bridge/structure work, 30% for rehabilitation; profit 10% including overhead. This project-type choice is independent of large/medium/small quantity columns and requires explicit selection.

Bridge overhead includes site setup/access, administration/supervision/as-built documentation, mobilization, camps/worker transport, quality-control testing, minor tools/survey/setting out, temporary diversion, watch/ward, traffic management, environment, sundries, finance and insurance/compensation.
Materials priced at site including crushing/source cost, loading, carriage, unloading and stacking. Where analysis separately includes haul, check its scope to prevent duplication.
Highly skilled bridge labour includes first-class mason, carpenter, first-class blacksmith, welder, plumber, first-class electrician and mechanics. One mate per 25 labourers.
Bridge bearings and expansion joints use approved manufacturer quotations; normal/compound curing covered, steam curing within precast PSC analysis.
Special structures/erection techniques and changed sizes/specifications require project-specific analyses. Floating barges for deep/wide water crossings provided separately.
Well sinking covers 6–12 m diameter and 12x6 m Twin-D wells; other geometry requires approved proportional/project analysis.
Concrete well-staining lifts 2–2.5 m, free fall at most 1.5 m, layers 450 mm.
Manual/mechanical foundation excavation alternatives; backfill and use surplus locally except marshy soil disposal. Rock excavation considered to 3 m depth.
Dewatering where needed; site conditions may omit it. No dewatering during open-foundation placement and 24 hours after, or within 7 days of bottom-plug casting.
Concrete batching plant generally within 1 km; longer lead priced in tonne-km. Coarse/fine aggregate per printed IS383 reference, approved mix design required.
Pneumatic well sinking specialized; source restricts depth to 30 m below normal water level and calls for medical supervision.
Pile-driving rigs include power units/accessories; retained driven-pile steel casing priced separately. Pile concrete includes 600 mm sacrificial head allowance.
Pile-cap levelling M15, open-foundation levelling 100 mm M10. Foundation-rock embedment protection M15 to 0.6 m hard/1.5 m soft rock, then cement-grouted boulders.
Well-curb concrete at least M25, reinforcement minimum 72 kg/cum excluding bond rods; steel protection plate at least 10 mm through curb, 6 mm above limited to 3 m.
Bottom-plug mix minimum cement 330 kg/cum and about 150 mm slump; plug top at least 300 mm above curb.
Pile concrete at least M35, cement minimum 400 kg/cum; pile embeds 50 mm into cap with full anchorage. Cap thickness at least max(0.6 m,1.5 pile diameters).

source_context.dependency_costing_policy: Resolve referenced sub-analysis directly; review markup and carriage boundaries to prevent duplicate charges.
source_context.source_lead_symbol_policy: Preserve printed L1; actual water and material/plant leads are independent project parameters with no defaults.
